fieldData.job-spec:
What is the job?

RDX Works is looking for a Commercial Controller who is a management accountant by training with strong experience in FP&A; preparing and reviewing short term and long term forecasts for group companies and planning for cashflow & treasury management. You will have joint responsibility for group management accounts.  You will lead financial planning across teams, leading to a clear understanding of divisional resource requirements and expected billing for clients.  You will provide support to divisional leads on setting budgets and other projects as required.  You will also be the point person for collating and reporting financial and non-financial actual data to our clients in monthly reports.  You will ensure that the appropriate commercial documentation is in place for internal and external clients through various Statement of Work schedules.

You will also support the finance team in organising and executing other activities, such as managing the options scheme and monitoring correct execution of the dividends scheme.  You are an inquisitive person who can think forward and anticipate future problems and solutions ahead of time. You are strong in planning, highly organised and meticulous on detail, but flexible enough to adapt when plans and circumstances change.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and direct the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts across projects and reporting on monthly variances.
  • Prepare and publish timely monthly financial statements across all entities
  • Manage month-end and year-end close process
  • Manage and comply with local and government reporting requirements and tax filings
  • Develop and maintain accurate registers of options holders and shareholders, and of any dividend distributions.
  • Ensure correct commercial documentation is in place.

What are we looking for?

  • You’re an ambitious and proactive, experienced finance person who can work well in and across teams and can take responsibility for managing elements of finance in a growing company.
  • You are highly organised and a natural completer-finisher: you like to check things off.  A clear to-do list set out and completed brings you great satisfaction.  Your spreadsheets are immaculate and you take pride in ensuring everything is correctly reported.
  • You have a calm and logical approach. 
  • You have a broad range of experience working across teams to get things done properly and on time and you know what makes for a smooth experience.
  • You’re intelligent, inquisitive, quick to learn and a versatile operator. No one at Radix winds up only doing what’s in their job description, and adaptability is essential!

What do you need?

  • Experience with creating financial forecasts and statements 
  • Experience in setting, monitoring and reporting KPIs
  • Understanding of commercial contracts
  • You may have hands-on financial management experience from accounting, banking or consulting backgrounds. E.g. 5+ years post qualification experience, ACCA/ACA/CIMA qualified with good technical knowledge, i.e. you understand what the numbers mean and why they are there.
  • Preferably good knowledge of accounting principles and procedures
  • High quality Excel skills creating and manipulating spreadsheets, including 3 statement modeling 

Things That Will Really Help You Stand Out

  • Previous management of complex intercompany 
  • Knowledge, understanding of and enthusiasm for crypto currencies and DeFi
  • Experience in working with regulatory issues and compliance


If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply here or email farrah@radixdlt.com for more information.   


RDX Works - Who are we? 

You’ve heard of Bitcoin (BTC) - the world’s first decentralized peer-to-peer digital money system - and Ethereum (ETH) - the decentralized computer for the world.  Radix (XRD) builds on these concepts to deliver the decentralized infrastructure for global finance (aka decentralised finance, “DeFi”) with the Radix network.

RDX Works is the technology team who built the core of the Radix network and continue to support the project.  We're a driven team who believe we’re at the earliest stages of a global financial revolution.  DeFi is already enabling pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product, without requiring the central authorities or siloed infrastructure of traditional institutions. 

DeFi has grown assets under management from $1 billion to $100 billion in less than a year. This is still a rounding error on the $111 trillion dollars+ held in traditional finance.  Nonetheless, the current decentralized public ledgers that DeFi is running on have fundamental challenges in security, scaling and parallelisation of transactions.

Radix has gone back to first principles to develop the right technical solution and created the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi.  An infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite for mass adoption.  Radix is also blazing a new trail in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration. 

At RDX Works we're focused on delivering the technology to take DeFi from billions to trillions. We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like.  We need you to join the team to help bring this vision to reality.
